necessary_context.content: M is an n-dimensional simply connected manifold with a complete Riemannian metric of sectional curvature at most zero. exp_x:T_xM→M is a diffeomorphism. Probability measures in the centerpoint statements are absolutely continuous with respect to Riemannian volume.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.3, Section 1.2; p.14, Appendix A
necessary_context.name: Hadamard setting

necessary_context.content: H_x(v)={exp_x(w):w∈T_xM, <w,v>_x<0}. These open halfspaces need not be geodesically convex. A beta-centerpoint c satisfies mu(H_c(v))≤1-beta for every v∈T_cM. The displayed definition includes v=0, yielding an empty set.
necessary_context.name: Halfspaces and centerpoints

necessary_context.content: For the cut implication, a supplied v at x must satisfy f(y)≥f(x)+<v,Log_x(y)>_x for every y in the geodesically convex domain S. No measure assumption or subgradient-existence theorem is needed for this conditional implication.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.3, Definition 5 and following subgradient definition; p.4, Lemma 7
necessary_context.name: Subgradient on the domain
